about: The alleluia of the formulary “Saint Joseph the Worker” in the 1962 Roman Missal.

seg.tr: Allelúja, allelúja. In whatever tribulation they shall cry to me, I will hear them and be their protector always. Allelúja. Obtain to us, O Joseph, to lead an innocent life; and may it ever be safe through thy patronage. Allelúja.
